caption: The drawing shows a ceramic teapot with a rounded body, a curved handle on the right, and a long spout on the left. The surface of the teapot is mostly off-white, with a wide band of stippled pinkish-purple coloring around the upper section of the body and the rim of the lid. A large red flower with dark red shading and three green leaves is illustrated on the side of the teapot's body. The lid is domed and topped with a small, sculpted, white knob resembling a flower bud. The handle features a slight decorative ridge at the top, and the spout has a gentle curve, narrowing to a small tip with a tan accent at the very end. The background is plain, uncolored, and featureless.
title: Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
